notes: 여자아이 is a specific compound of 'woman' (여자) and 'child' (아이). While you can use '여자' (woman) and '아이' (child) separately, this term is the standard, natural way to refer to a girl as a child.
Be aware that in very casual speech, you might hear the shortened form '여아', but this is much more formal or clinical and not used for talking to or about children in daily life.
